description: 兵升变马钩杀：升马闪将，车踏f8将死
explanation_en: A pawn promotes to a knight with check, then a discovered check clears the way for the rook to deliver hook mate.

intro.popup: 💡 升变马钩杀：白兵在f7，白车在e8，白兵在f5，黑王在h7——兵升变哪种子才能组成钩杀？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Hook mate with a knight promotion: White's pawns are on f7 and f5, the rook on e8, and Black's king on h7. Which piece should the pawn promote to for a hook mate?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：升变为马！f8=N+驱王，Ng6+闪将，Rf8#车马兵构成钩形将死——升变为后反而无法完成钩杀！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Promote to a knight! f8=N+ drives the king, Ng6+ gives discovered check, and Rf8# completes the rook-knight-pawn hook. A queen promotion would not work.

moves.popup: 白兵f7升变为马！f8=N+，马攻击h7，逼迫黑王离开h7移往g8。
moves.popup_en: The pawn promotes to a knight on f8 with check. The knight attacks h7 and forces the black king to move to g8.
The black king is forced to g8.

moves.popup: 白马Ng6+发现将！马从f8跳到g6，让开f8格，揭开白车e8沿第8列攻击g8的线路——发现将！
moves.popup_en: Ng6+! The knight moves from f8 to g6, uncovering the rook on e8 along the eighth rank to give discovered check against the king on g8.

moves.popup: 黑王逃往f7——进入钩杀的最后陷阱！
moves.popup_en: The black king moves to f7 and enters the final hook-mate trap.

moves.popup: 白车Rf8#钩杀！车到f8，马在g6，兵在f5——三者构成钩形，黑王f7被围，e6/e8/g8被车封，g7/h5/h7被马封，g6/e6被兵封——无路可逃！
moves.popup_en: Rf8# delivers hook mate! The rook on f8, knight on g6, and pawn on f5 form the hook around the king on f7. The rook, knight, and pawn cover its escape squares; there is no way out.
